provenance.procedure: GET /movie/700?append_to_response=external_ids with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb movie-700.
provenance.note: Synthesised: a film's detail with external_ids appended in the same call (append_to_response), the one request a matched film costs after its search. The client reads id, title, release_date, overview, poster_path, backdrop_path, the genre names and the imdb id (present both at the top level and under external_ids for a movie), tolerating the rest.
